params.name: battery_gte
params.description: Filter devices with battery capacity greater than or equal to this value (in mAh).

params.name: chipset_contains
params.description: Substring match for the chipset name (e.g. Snapdragon, Tensor).

params.name: ram_between
params.description: Range filter for RAM (e.g. "8,12" for between 8GB and 12GB).

items.docs: Retrieve a list of mobile devices matching the specified filter parameters.

params.name: manufacturer
params.description: The name of the manufacturer (e.g. Google, Samsung, Apple).

items.docs: Retrieve all tracked mobile devices from a specific manufacturer.

params.name: chipset
params.description: The URL-friendly chipset name (e.g. Tensor-G4, Snapdragon-8-Gen-3).

items.docs: Retrieve all mobile devices powered by a specific SoC/chipset.

params.name: manufacturer
params.description: The name of the manufacturer (e.g. Google).
